Ava (Partnerships): Heads-up — planning a 4-day Lighthouse SI Bootcamp (partners: two strategic SIs) week of May 5. Purpose: hands-on private deploy, hardware validation, and a fast-path certification + joint announce. Need volunteers for curriculum, labs, shipping, and comms by EOW. Signup form: https://forms.gle/bootcamp-signup (please fill ASAP). :speaker: 
Maya (Solutions Eng): I can own the deployment lab + run the KV/quantization session. recommend adding a short prework notebook for model-to-runtime parity.
Diego (CloudSI): Seat cap? we'll want roster early for travel + env prep. also how many hardware vouchers and what's the SKU?
Sam (Enablement): I'll draft a certification rubric — suggest practical checkpoint on Day 3 and a proctored exam on Day 4. Can run mock exam session the week prior.
Priya (Supply Ops): For shipping: need partner VAT/tax IDs and preferred courier. lead time 10 business days for GPU kits. recommend using partner-vouchers SKU: PRTNR-HW-2026. Share addresses by Tue.
Ravi (Field Marketing): If we plan a joint announcement, what's the embargo window? will need co-branding assets and brief (one-pager) two weeks before publish. also can we line up a partner case study draft?
Liam (Legal): For co-announcement we'll need an addendum to the partner MSA (marketing opt-in). I'll circulate a one-pager template; partners should sign before public release.
Maya (Solutions Eng): +1 on prework. I'll create a short repo with instructions and a minimal test script: ```bash
git clone https://github.com/redwood/si-bootcamp-prework
cd prework && ./run_test.sh
```
Diego (CloudSI): Partner list: sending CSV in DM. seat cap target 12 engineers (6 per partner) — hope that fits hardware availability. will partners cover travel?
Ava (Partnerships): Good call on numbers — let's target 8 seats per partner for safety (max 16). Redwood covers local travel stipend; partners cover international.
Sam (Enablement): Exam logistics: proctor window options: Thu 09:00-11:00 or 16:00-18:00 PT. Which works for EU partners? we can add an evening slot.
Priya (Supply Ops): Shipping note: some APAC customs require commercial invoice with model numbers. I'll attach template. Also recommend sending one spare kit per partner to avoid downtime.
Ravi (Field Marketing): Draft timeline: May 5-8 bootcamp; press embargo until May 20; draft co-branded one-pager by May 8; case study first draft by May 27. Is that aggressive?
Liam (Legal): Timeline okay, but need partner sign-off on quotes and trademarks by May 10.
OnboardingBot: Calendar invite created: "Lighthouse SI Bootcamp — Redwood x Partners" May 5 09:00 PT — May 8 17:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=SI_BOOTCAMP_2026
Diego (CloudSI): Can we get a short checklist for network/VPC prep? partners reported NAT/firewall issues last time.
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll post a netprep checklist to the repo by Wed. includes ports, NTP, kernel modules, and an `nginx` reverse-proxy snippet for KV cache forwarding.
Ava (Partnerships): Action items I'll track:
- Maya: prework repo + deployment lab (due Wed)
- Priya: shipping plan + customs template (due Tue)
- Sam: certification rubric + proctor windows (due Thu)
- Ravi: comms timeline + asset checklist (due Fri)
- Liam: MSA addendum draft (due Fri)
- Diego: final partner roster + seat confirmations (due Tue)
Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept. I'll follow up with a short project tracker later today.
Sam (Enablement): :thumbsup: I'll also schedule the mock exam slot.
Priya (Supply Ops): :thumbsup: sending list to ops channel now.
Diego (CloudSI): Sending roster tonight.
Ravi (Field Marketing): Adding draft brief to marketing drive.
Liam (Legal): Will circulate the addendum for e-sign tomorrow.
Ava (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anyone else wants to join lab day or shadow, drop your name here. :pray:
